questions.question: What occasion is connected to Psalm 34?
options: When David feigned madness before Abimelech
When David numbered the people and sinned
When David hid from Saul in the wilderness
When David fled from Absalom across the Jordan
questions.answer: When David feigned madness before Abimelech

questions.question: What does David invite the reader to do?
options: Taste and see that the LORD is good
Trust in the LORD with all your heart
Wait for the LORD; be strong and take courage
Be still, and know that I am God
questions.answer: Taste and see that the LORD is good

questions.question: David says the LORD is near to the brokenhearted and saves the crushed in spirit.
I will bless the LORD at all times; His praise will always be on my _____.
The eyes of the LORD are toward the _____, and his ears toward their cry.
